summary.text: Maxine Dibert, a Democrat, has represented District 31 (Fairbanks) in the Alaska House of Representatives since 2023.

paragraphs.text: The legislative biography says Dibert was born and raised in Fairbanks, is Koyukon Athabascan, and taught for over 21 years in the Fairbanks North Star Borough School District before being elected.
It lists a bachelor's degree in education from the University of Alaska Fairbanks and a master's degree in education from Lesley University.
